pages.text: Hannah prayed and prayed for a baby. God heard her, and she had a son named Samuel. She promised that he would serve God.
When Samuel was a little boy, he lived in the temple and helped the priest Eli. One night he heard a voice call his name.
Three times Samuel ran to Eli. Then Eli said, "It is God. Say, 'Speak, Lord, I am listening.'" Samuel did, and God spoke to him.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Prayer is talking to God and listening to God. Samuel listened when God called him, and we can too.

pages.text: God chose David, a young shepherd, to be a future king. David took care of his sheep and sang songs to God.
A giant soldier named Goliath scared the whole army of Israel. Every day he shouted, "Send someone to fight me!" No one dared.
David said, "God helped me against the lion and the bear. He will help me now." He picked five smooth stones from a stream.
David ran toward Goliath with his sling. He swung it and let a stone fly. Goliath fell down! God had helped David.
Everyone cheered, because God had saved them. David knew that the victory came from God and not from his own strength.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: David was small, but he trusted God and was brave. God helps us find courage when we trust Him.

pages.text: King Saul liked David at first. But when the people cheered for David, Saul became jealous and angry.
David played the harp to calm Saul, but Saul's anger grew. He tried to catch David, so David had to run away and hide.
One day Saul came into a cave where David was hiding. David could have hurt him, but he only cut off a corner of Saul's cloak.
David said, "I will not harm the king God chose." He bowed and showed Saul the cloak. Saul cried and said, "You are kinder than I am."
Saul's son Jonathan was David's best friend. They promised to be loyal to each other, and David chose to be kind even to his enemy.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: David was kind to someone who was unkind to him. Jesus teaches us to love even those who are hard to love.
